eps.o: In a futuristic LA, mysterious Outer Ring sushi chef Jiro sets off a violent chain of events after a customer violates his one rule: no soy sauce.
Jiro is tasked with making a special delivery to an LA food festival, but must survive a gauntlet of bounty hunter food trucks along the way.
Jiro takes on a new apprentice and learns to cook a controversial new dish and finds himself in the crosshairs of a meticulous assassin.
Bob and Rose's rivalry explodes into a damaging war. Cynda targets Jiro in her investigation and revisits her tragic family history in the process.
An injured Jiro is relentlessly pursued by Bob's goons. Left with no choice, Jiro is forced to prepare a special omakase for Bob's right-hand man.
